specification: Actual donor/owner and permission to use feed
why_required: Chain of custody, sample availability and authorization
needed_evidence: Owner/source, written access status, intake record
model_gate: Before physical work or sample-specific model

specification: Panel manufacturer, model, year and datasheet
why_required: Defines construction, dimensions, cell count, nameplate and likely technology
needed_evidence: Label photographs and product datasheet
model_gate: Before component CAD and mass inventory

specification: Mono/poly and cell architecture (PERC/TOPCon/HJT/other)
why_required: Metallization and Ag loading change with cell generation/design
needed_evidence: Datasheet or microscopy/material characterization

specification: Module construction and glass/backsheet layout
why_required: Defines component streams and cut/disassembly geometry
needed_evidence: Visual inspection and manufacturer documentation

specification: Feed count, IDs, intact mass, dimensions and condition
why_required: Sets actual model basis and representativeness
needed_evidence: Registered samples, calibrated scale and dimensions

specification: Disassembly sequence, tools and output stream definitions
why_required: Material routing and contamination depend on tools and sequence
needed_evidence: Reviewed procedure and stream-ID map

specification: Frame/J-box/cable removal efficiency and weighing repeatability
why_required: Closes Stage 1 mass balance
needed_evidence: Replicated weighed disassembly records

specification: Mechanical liberation mechanism and geometry
why_required: Sets stress, fracture and fragment population
needed_evidence: Crusher/mill/tool design, force/speed/gap settings

specification: Measured size/shape/density distributions by material class
why_required: Required for particle flow and representative sampling
needed_evidence: Sieve/image analysis and density method
model_gate: Before Stage 2 population and Stage 3 feed

specification: Ag liberation and association with silicon/copper/polymer
why_required: Total particle mass is not Ag mass; necessary to estimate separation selectivity
needed_evidence: Microscopy/EDS or mineralogical liberation analysis plus assays

specification: Feed mass, moisture and homogenization/splitting procedure
why_required: Affects process response and representative assay
needed_evidence: Measured feed and lab-approved sample plan

specification: Separator geometry, electrode/roller/splitter dimensions
why_required: Defines electric field and particle trajectories
needed_evidence: Dimensioned CAD or drawings

specification: Voltage, polarity, rotor speed and feed rate
why_required: Boundary conditions and operating point
needed_evidence: Design targets and safe operating range from supervisor

specification: Particle charge/charge-to-mass and electrical conductivity by material
why_required: Governs force and separation response; conductivity alone is insufficient
needed_evidence: Material characterization or calibrated bench measurements

specification: Humidity, surface condition, particle shape and collision/contact model
why_required: Can change charging and trajectories
needed_evidence: Environmental record and representative particle samples

specification: Assay provider, Ag method and sample preparation
why_required: Defines measurement basis and whether concentration/purity claims are supportable
needed_evidence: Lab quote/method, sample requirement, method validation

specification: Method detection/quantification limits, uncertainty and reference materials
why_required: Determines whether low Ag levels and balance closure are resolvable
needed_evidence: Lab method performance statement

specification: Sample mass, aliquot count, homogenization and retained-sample plan
why_required: Controls representativeness and sampling uncertainty
needed_evidence: Approved sampling protocol

specification: Software access, version, license terms, CPU/RAM/GPU
current: Python/NumPy only confirmed; no external solver confirmed
why_required: Determines runnable model and traceable version
needed_evidence: Account entitlement or installed solver version/system inventory

specification: Thermal delamination placement in latest stage numbering

why_required: Prevents stage and stream mislabeling
